summary: Iter 19 backend PASS (15/15 pytest green), frontend MOSTLY PASS with 1 CRITICAL UX bug on AI chat. Backend: all 4 demo login-flyter (passenger/driver/fleet_owner/superadmin) return correct role, /api/ai/chat responds to 'Hei' in ~2.5s and stays <3s over 4 sequential turns in the same session (history-replay fix confirmed), 504/502 error paths intact via asyncio.wait_for(25s). Regressions green: /api/health, /api/ai/translate, /api/ai/transcribe, /api/push/native-subscribe, /api/fleet/export/monthly, /api/cars/nearby, /api/trips/estimate, /api/driver/pending, /api/superadmin/fleet-applications (returns 5+ apps as expected), /api/fleet/payouts. Frontend E2E on 390x844 mobile: (1) /login shows 4 demo buttons with data-testid demo-passenger|driver|fleet|admin — each fills correct email+password, (2) demo-passenger → /app ✓, demo-driver → /driver ✓, demo-fleet → /fleet with 'Oslo Nord Taxi' visible ✓, demo-admin → /loyver with 'Løyvehaver-panelet' header + 5 nye søknader + 12 sjåfører som venter cards ✓, (3) /app/settings shows settings-payment-methods entry → clicking navigates to /app/payment-methods ✓, (4) /app/ai chat sends 'Hei' + 3 more turns and receives replies in 2.36–2.80s each (WELL under 10s regression bar), BUT only when the send is triggered via Enter key — the chat-send button click is intercepted by BottomNav's floating '← Til hjem' pill (see critical bug below).

ui_bugs.issue: On /app/ai the mint chat-send button (bottom-right of input row) sits BEHIND the floating BottomNav '← Til hjem' pill (data-testid nav-home-back, absolute bottom-0 z-[1005]). Screenshot confirms overlap. Real touch users tapping 'send' hit 'Til hjem' and get navigated to /app instead of sending the message. Enter-key still works (that's why keyboard test passes and backend logs show POST /api/ai/chat only when Enter is used). Same overlap likely affects the chat-mic empty-state button as well. This is the primary reason user reported 'AI-chat fungerte ikke ordentlig'.

issues: Chat input row lacks bottom padding to clear the fixed BottomNav pill (~72px). Fix options: (a) render Shell withNav={false} for /app/ai, (b) add pb-[80px] to AIChat scroll container + input, or (c) hide nav-home-back on /app/ai.

action_items: HIGH: Fix chat-send / nav-home-back z-index overlap on /app/ai. Simplest patch: change route to <Shell withNav={false}> for /app/ai (like /app/settings), OR add pb-24 to AIChat root + adjust endRef scroll. Verified: backend AI chat works — the frontend cannot invoke it via touch.
Consider hiding the '← Til hjem' pill on any route that has its own bottom-anchored primary action (AIChat, PaymentMethods setup flow, etc.), or lowering its z-index below page-level bottom bars.
critical_code_review_comments: AIChat.jsx line 165 fallback error message still says 'Beklager, jeg fikk et hikk' — review said it should be replaced with more specific 502/504 messages coming from backend. Current code DOES fall through to that generic string when e.response?.data?.detail is empty (network error, CORS, etc.). Consider adding a 504-specific catch: if(e.response?.status===504) return 'KJAPP AI bruker litt lengre tid nå — prøv igjen om et øyeblikk.'; if(e.response?.status===502) return 'AI-tjenesten er midlertidig utilgjengelig.'

The remaining blocker is a pure CSS/layout overlap: BottomNav's '← Til hjem' floating pill (BottomNav.jsx line 44-57, absolute bottom-0 z-[1005]) sits ON TOP of AIChat's chat-send button (AIChat.jsx line 365-399, normal document flow at bottom of page). rca of the issue: RCA — AI chat 'not working': BottomNav.jsx renders a 'Til hjem' link (data-testid=nav-home-back) as an absolute-positioned pill at bottom-0 z-[1005] whenever the current route is NOT /app. On /app/ai, this pill visually overlaps the chat input row (see attached screenshot). Reproduction: (1) login ola@, (2) go to /app/ai, (3) type any non-booking message, (4) TAP send. Actual: page navigates to /app; no POST /api/ai/chat fires. Expected: reply appears in <10s. Mitigation options ranked: (A) BEST — change /app/ai route to <Shell withNav={false}> in App.js line 164; (B) add bottom padding (pb-24) to AIChat root container so input clears the nav; (C) conditionally hide the 'Til hjem' pill inside BottomNav when location.pathname === '/app/ai' (or add a route-specific className).
